fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: Rushes 5 tiles to the target and tears at it for 14 damage, making it [Slowed] for 3 seconds and [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Clod Flurry
fusions.desc: Kicks up 3 clods at once in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Heaped Barricade
fusions.desc: Heaps up a barricade 6 tiles across ahead of you for 8 seconds that blocks enemies.

fusions.name: Packed Ground
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
